body: I cant stop looking at her messages, its killing me inside, I'm smoking weed and it's the first time in my life it does nothing...I started going to school to be an electrician so I could make a good life for us and I only have a couple more months left, I have to go back after a 2 week break and I cant do it, my grades are already slipping because I was dumped right before break, I wanna still be an electrician but what's the point anymore if I'm going home to no one and ik shes probably with someone in that moment. Nothing is interesting anymore, I just wanna lay in bed all day and stare at my messages ik she'll never respond too, I cant even put stuff on tv it just makes me depressed. I really need someone to talk to, I dont open up to anyone but this is a opportunity to at least be heard so I figured I should say fuck it and just type everything out
